gloss: the member these asks were put to

every untimed ask put to the member, by the hash of its code, the registers, shape and launches it was put with, its count of cases and the hash of its cases, and what came back: answers and the word of every case in the order of the cases, or illegal, nothing or censored and the refusal, censored where the watchdog ended it before it came back; an ask the gate held never reached the member and is not here

every timed ask, put each time it is asked and each time a sample of its own, by its identity as an ask's, and what came back: answers and the nanoseconds its launches took together on the member's own timer, or illegal, nothing or censored and the refusal
a path read off the asks above: a pair of the bridge and its verdict, closed [<address>] <case> or open <count>, an open pair the question a further pass takes up
